env TARGET=$WORK/.codex/skills
env SRC=$WORK/source
env SRC2=$WORK/source2

# Install skill_a from SRC
exec axen source add $SRC
exec axen install source --all --targets=codex
exists $TARGET/skill_a/SKILL.md

# Try to install skill_a from SRC2, should warn about conflict
exec axen source add $SRC2
exec axen install source2 --all --targets=codex
stdout 'Conflict Detected'

# Force install skill_a from SRC2
exec axen source add $SRC2
exec axen install source2 --all --targets=codex --force
exists $TARGET/skill_a/SKILL.md

-- source/skill_a/SKILL.md --
name: skill_a
-- source/axen.json --
{"axen_version": "1", "name": "mysrc", "skills":{"skill_a":{"path":"skill_a"}}}
-- source2/skill_a/SKILL.md --
name: skill_a
-- source2/axen.json --
{"axen_version": "1", "name": "mysrc", "skills":{"skill_a":{"path":"skill_a"}}}
